mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, nickname, profile_image, user_city, user_district, user_dong) VALUES (#{id}, #{nickname}, #{profileImage} , #{userCity}, #{userDistrict}, #{userDong})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, user_city = #{userCity}, user_district = #{userDistrict}, user_dong = #{userDong} WHERE id = #{id}
